equations.CBS_send_slope: SendSlope S = IdleSlope I - LinkRate C.
equations.CBS_service_curve: Per egress port p: beta_p(t) = max(0, I * (t - T0)), with T0 = hiCredit/I + L_block/C. Here hiCredit=0 and L_block=0 => T0=0.

equations.per_port_delay: D_{p,f} = T_f + sigma_f / R_f = T0 + (sum_{j in X} sigma_j)/R + sigma_f / (R - sum_{j in X} rho_j).
equations.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_{p in path(f)} D_{p,f} + D_fixed.

equations.CBS_service_curve: For each egress port p (class A): beta_p(t) = R * max(0, t - T_p), with R = IdleSlope (Mbps), T_p = T_base + T_cbs.
equations.T_cbs: T_cbs = ((C/IdleSlope) - 1) * (L_max_bits / C) = L_max_bits / 300 (microseconds) for C=100 Mbps and IdleSlope=75 Mbps.
equations.port_delay_bound: For port p with aggregate alpha_p(t) = Sigma_p + Rho_p t: D_p = T_p + Sigma_p / (R - Rho_p).
equations.end_to_end_WCD: For flow f, WCD_f = sum over egress ports on its path of D_p.

all_parameters_used.arrival_curves: alpha_f(t) = b_f + r_f * t, where b_f = payload_bytes, r_f = payload_bytes / period_us

all_parameters_used.delay_bound_formula: WCD_f = T_e2e + b_f / (R_e2e - r_f), valid if r_f < R_e2e

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + r_f * t, with b_f = payload_bytes, r_f = payload_bytes / period_us
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_i(t) = rho * (t - T_i)^+, where rho = IdleSlope = 0.75*C, T_i = (H_i - L_i)/rho + B_block; H_i = 0 (no higher-prio), L_i = -0.25 * L_max_A_on_port, B_block = 0 (no lower-prio considered). D_fixed per port (prop + switch + sync) is added into T_i.
WCD_calculation.leftover_service_under_FIFO: For flow f at port i with other Class A flows j sharing the same queue: R_i^f = rho - sum_{j != f} r_j, T_i^f = T_i + (sum_{j != f} b_j)/rho.
WCD_calculation.concatenation_over_path: beta_f^e2e = (R_e2e, T_e2e) with R_e2e = min_i R_i^f and T_e2e = sum_i T_i^f.
WCD_calculation.delay_bound: WCD_f = T_e2e + b_f / (R_e2e - r_f), provided r_f < R_e2e.
WCD_calculation.units: Rates in bytes/us, times in microseconds (us), credits in bytes.

WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_k(t) = I * [ t - (tau_credit_i + d_sw + d_prop + e_sync) ]^+, with I = IdleSlope = 0.75*C, tau_credit_i = L_i * (C - I) / (C * I).
WCD_calculation.path_service_curve: Concatenation of LR servers: R_path = min_k I = I; T_path = sum_k (tau_credit_i + d_sw + d_prop + e_sync) = h * (tau_credit_i + 3µs).
WCD_calculation.WCD_equation_per_flow: WCD_i = t_prop_src_first_link + T_path + sigma_i / (R_path - rho_i) = 1µs + h*(tau_i + 3µs) + L_i / (I - rho_i).
notes: h is the number of switch egress hops (hop_count - 1 from provided path).

equations: Arrival curve per flow i: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = L_i (Bytes), rho_i = L_i / P_i (Bytes/us).
CBS parameters: I = IdleSlope = 0.75 * C, S = SendSlope = I - C (negative).
Non-preemptive blocking latency: T_np = Lmax / C.
Credit recovery latency (no lower-priority traffic ⇒ hiCredit=0, loCredit = -((C - I)/C)*Lmax): T_credit = |loCredit| / I = ((C - I)/(C*I)) * Lmax.
CBS service (per egress port): beta_p(t) = I * [t - T_cbs]^+, with T_cbs = T_np + T_credit.
We add fixed per-hop delay: T_fixed = t_prop + t_sw + t_sync = 3 us.

Leftover service at a port for flow i with cross-traffic set X: beta_i^p(t) = (I - rho_X) * [ t - (T_cbs + T_fixed + sigma_X / (I - rho_X)) ]^+, where rho_X = sum_{j in X} rho_j and sigma_X are the input bursts of cross flows at that port.
Per-port delay bound for flow i: d_i^p = sigma_i_in / (I - rho_X - rho_i) + T_cbs + T_fixed + sigma_X / (I - rho_X), requiring I > (rho_i + rho_X).
Burst update across a port: sigma_i_out = sigma_i_in + rho_i * (T_cbs + T_fixed + sigma_X / (I - rho_X)).
End-to-end WCD for a flow is the sum of its per-port delay bounds along its path.
